[title] Survey Results Summary statistics Quantiles and boxplots Python/Colab Outlook Objectives of today’s lecture
[body] • Understand quantiles and boxplots • Learn how to use Python to generate descriptive statistics and graphical summaries of datasets (using Colab)
[body] Prof. Oke (UMass Amherst) CEE 260/MIE 273 M1b: Summarizing Data September 10, 2026 4 / 16
